content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle each offer platforms that facilitate online sales, but their geographic limitations heavily restrict creators in many parts of the world. Stripe operates in just 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving millions unable to use their services. PayPal's policy of freezing accounts can result in funds being held for up to 180 days, creating significant uncertainty for sellers. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH provides a full-stack solution that allows creators to sell digital products directly, with complete ownership and control over transactions, independent of location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The major platforms often exclude regions based on risk assessments or regulatory compliance, isolating creators in countries like Pakistan and Zimbabwe from their services. This exclusion not only stifles entrepreneurship but also perpetuates financial isolation. For example, PayPal's operations in these regions are either heavily restricted or non-existent, leaving creators unable to access crucial payment processing. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is built to operate globally, enabling creators in restricted countries to deploy solutions that work without reliance on traditional payment processors. COREMERCH specifically targets these markets, ensuring that creators can connect with customers anywhere.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Mainstream platforms often impose high fees and delayed payment processing that can hinder a creator's cash flow. For instance, Stripe takes a percentage of each transaction, alongside fixed fees, which can accumulate quickly, especially for lower-priced digital products. Payment delays can extend to several days, impacting a creator's ability to reinvest in their business. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, utilizes systems like NOWPayments that charge a minimal 0.5% fee and provide instant payment verification. This means that creators receive funds quickly, allowing them to maintain liquidity and make faster business decisions.
Complete ownership means no platform dependency after setup.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of the sales process is a critical aspect that separates traditional platforms from sovereign commerce infrastructure. On platforms like Gumroad, creators often remain dependent on the platform for transactions and customer data. If the platform fails or suspends an account, access to vital sales data can be lost. In contrast, with COREMERCH, once the stack is deployed, the creator owns everything—no ongoing fees, no subscription model, and no access from COREMERCH after delivery. Automation in payment processing and product delivery further enhances the creator's ability to operate independently, ensuring that they can focus on their craft rather than navigating platform restrictions.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on your specific needs and the payment landscape in your region. If you're operating in a country with limited access to traditional payment processors, deploying a sovereign commerce stack is the clear choice. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH offers a comprehensive solution, allowing you to set up a fully operational shop within 48 hours. With features like automated payment processing and complete ownership, this stack is designed for creators looking to circumvent the limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Instant crypto payments keep your cash flow smooth and uninterrupted.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
